import numpy as np

def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    new_capacities = bins - item
    return 1 / (1 + np.abs(new_capacities - np.round(new_capacities / item) * item))
genes.thought: The novel score function prioritizes bins by maximizing the proximity of the remaining capacity to a power-of-two threshold after item placement, encouraging tighter packing.
